name: Orbital patrol
objective: Patrol the orbit of {sector_planet} and engage the raiders.

brief.text: Raiders have been shadowing the traffic in orbit of {sector_planet}. Hold the orbit for a turn and see them off.
Your {side_name} patrol pay is the reward.

result.log: Orbital patrol: outnumbered over the planet, the fleet drew off.
